correctness.rationale: The definition of GP(10,2) and its line graph is explicit. The standalone verifier constructs every one of 1022 scale-two simplices, checks 468 pair removals individually against all current cofaces, and confirms a connected 16-vertex closed triangulated surface with all vertex links single cycles and Euler characteristic 2. Elementary collapses plus closed-surface classification prove VR≤2≃S2 over the integers. Twenty independent scale-one triangle collapses leave a connected graph with 30 vertices and 40 edges, giving a wedge of 11 circles. The exact integer metric and inclusive scale avoid normalization ambiguity; no unproved infinite extrapolation is claimed.

value.rationale: The icosidodecahedron is a canonical 30-vertex Archimedean graph, not an arbitrarily selected slice. Its first metric thickening has a complete integral homotopy transition from 11 circles to one 2-sphere, unlike the nearby known graph Čech complex which retains 11 circles. The exactly checked 468-pair simple-homotopy certificate and manifold-link criterion provide a reusable motivated finite test case in the developing study of polyhedral graph Rips complexes; no general downstream theorem is presumed.
